name: Glittering Dream Orb
skillFull: When its skill is first activated, a large Dreamcloud appears in the sky for a certain amount of time, during which multiple Dreamclouds descend from the sky. The final Dreamcloud contains a hidden Dream Orb Jelly. After this phase ends, Dreamclouds continue to descend from the sky, creating Dreamcloud Jellies. Level up for more points for Dreamcloud Jellies and Dream Orb Jellies.
